page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1.4xlarge is a memory-optimized instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated physical cores powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz. The system architecture is x86_64, configured with 128.0 GB of system memory, yielding 8.0 GB of RAM per core. No local storage is bundled with this instance, and it lacks GPU acceleration. Network connectivity is defined by a baseline bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks show a contrast between single-core and multi-core capabilities. Single-core performance is generally weak, with stress-ng single-core and Geekbench single-core scores falling into the bottom 25 percent, and single-threaded gzip compression rated as poor. However, multi-core execution scales to average levels, as evidenced by middle-tier results in stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression. Memory bandwidth for both small and large blocks remains in the average tier, though Passmark memory scores are positioned in the bottom 25 percent.

Given the 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this instance is qualitatively cost-efficient for memory-intensive workloads that do not require high single-threaded CPU performance. It is suitable for database operations, caching layers like Redis, and moderate multi-threaded processing tasks. The lack of local storage requires relying on network-attached storage, which aligns with its 3 Gbps baseline network bandwidth.
